chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah from someone else from Aban from Muhammad ibn Muslim who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), 'Does anything from these timings prevent you from praying the Salat upon the deceased?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'No'.
ai.seo_question: Does the time of day prevent performing Salat al-Janazah?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that the general prohibition against praying during specific times (such as sunrise and sunset) does not extend to Salat al-Janazah, establishing it as a distinct act of worship with its own timing rules. This highlights the scholarly distinction between voluntary prayers (Sunnah) and the obligatory funeral prayer, affirming the flexibility of the latter to ensure the deceased is not delayed in their burial rites.
